raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions now holds 90 EUR-denominated rows, and silver_transactions sums them as if they were USD, so the USD gold totals are overstated or misstated. raw_fx_rates already provides one rate_to_usd per currency (EUR 1.25), so these amounts can be converted to USD in the silver layer.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(t.amount * f.rate_to_usd AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t JOIN raw_fx_rates f ON f.currency = t.currency WHERE t.status = 'POSTED';"}}
